# StorageDump

> StorageDump is a free, open-source Chrome extension that inspects and exports everything a website stores in your browser — cookies (including HttpOnly and partitioned), localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage and service workers — as lossless JSON or ZIP, entirely on your machine.

## What it does
- One panel for cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage, service workers and extension storage.
- Exports to JSON or ZIP (manifest + per-category files); nothing is read until you click Scan; no server.

## Install
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/storagedump/kihoghfekemdccfnpjefmggehpgnjnab
- From source: `npm install && npm run build`, then load `dist/` unpacked in chrome://extensions.

## Use
Open a site → StorageDump icon → Scan → Export all, or Open dashboard.
